summary: This table presents a financial performance summary for a company, comparing key metrics across three time periods: December 31, 2024, December 31, 2023, and September 30, 2024. Key metrics include revenues, gross profit, operating expenses, and net profit, with growth percentages calculated year-over-year (YoY) and quarter-over-quarter (QoQ). Notably, revenues increased from ₹38,821 million in 2023 to ₹41,764 million in 2024, reflecting a 7.6% growth YoY. The gross profit also saw a rise of 9.3% YoY, indicating improved profitability. Operating profit margins and net profit figures are highlighted, with net profit before minority interest reaching ₹9,670 million in 2024, up 12.2% from the previous year. The table also includes earnings per share (EPS) metrics, showing a slight increase in both basic and diluted EPS.
